entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Well, while I was travelling here,[n]I suddenly had this epiphany...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: So I had to hurry over and explain it[n]to you.
entries.uk: Тож я мусила поспішити й усе[n]вам пояснити.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Right... I've been wondering for a while[n]if there's any way I can bring some[n]personal flair to my fights in Mementos.
entries.uk: Так... Я вже давно думаю, чи можна[n]якось додати особистого стилю[n]моїм битвам у Мементосі.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: And you came up with something?

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: But, I do have a small favor to ask,[n][fName]-senpai...

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: I feel like... This move would allow me[n]to honor Kasumi properly.
entries.uk: Мені здається... цей прийом дозволить[n]мені гідно вшанувати Касумі.

entries.speaker: Sumire
entries.en: Thank you! This should make for one[n]killer routine!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: I've definitely never seen anything like[n]what she's planning—I can't wait for this!
entries.uk: Я точно ніколи не бачив нічого схожого[n]на її задум — не можу дочекатися!
